1 · Intro

When to use it.

Use Costing for Persons to enter or change where an assignment, or a single pay element, is charged. In many areas the finance partner does this, so confirm who owns it in your department.

Get the COA or POET string from your finance partner before you start.

Use this whenCosting fundamentals says the default won't work, or funding changed.

2 · Walk through

Step by step.

Follow along in Oracle HCM. Check off each step as you go.

Changing costing that already exists
UseWhen
UpdateA new costing starts on a date going forward. History is kept.
CorrectThe existing entry was wrong from the start.
End DateCosting should stop. Use the Pay Period End Date.
Delete RecordRemove an entry entered in error.

Watch-outs

  • Costing applies to a full pay period. Oracle uses the costing in effect on the Pay Period End Date and does not prorate.
  • Current and future changes: enter by the HCM Transaction Cutoff.
  • Prior periods (retro): also submit the Retro Costing Request Form (Salary) to Research Finance by the Retro Change Cutoff, usually two business days before the HCM Transaction Cutoff.
  • Source guide dated 01/27/2022, before the Redwood screens. Field names to confirm in a recorded demo.

Q2Your costing lines add up to 90%. What happens?

Q3You costed a grant (POET). What goes in the COA fields?

HCM Academy job aid · Costing Management

Enter or edit costing for a person

Use when: Costing fundamentals says the default won't work, or funding changed. · System: Oracle HCM (Costing for Persons)

  1. Our Workforce > Quick Actions > Show More > Costing for Persons.
  2. Search the person using Advanced Search, and set Effective As-of Date before you search.
    • Create, update, or correct: use the first day of the pay period (Pay Period Start Date).
    • End date a costing: use the Pay Period End Date.
    • Past date, such as a new hire's start date: set it to that date, or the person won't appear ("no data returned").
  3. Select the person, then select the Assignment on the left.
  4. Actions > Create, then:
    • Create Costing: for the whole assignment, or
    • Create Costing of Element: for one payment, such as a bonus. Pick the element code ending in Earnings Results.
  5. Enter the effective date (first day of the current or future pay period) and click OK.
  6. Under Create Cost Accounts, click Actions > Create (or +) to add a line.
  7. Enter each line. Percentages must total 100%.
    • COA string: Entity, Net Asset Class (for example, 05), Financial Unit, Program, Activity (000 if unused), VU_Function. Leave Account blank; payroll fills it. Use defaults for the other fields.
    • POET string (grants): always put the payroll clearing string in the COA fields: 380.05.38600.5140.000.000.000.VUI.0. Then enter Project, Organization, Expenditure Type (SalFac, SalStaff, or SalStud), and Task.
    • Leave Allocation Type blank.
  8. Review and click Submit. There's no workflow, so you won't get a notification.
  9. Run the HCM Cost Allocation Verification report. If your entry appears, fix it right away.
